name: Porto Boat Party
description: Dance on the Douro with live DJs and stunning city views as your backdrop. A quintessential Porto party experience.
longDescription:
The Porto Boat Party offers a dedicated nightlife event on the Douro River. This ticketed event is organized as a single-night experience, providing a platform for music and social gathering against the city's riverside panorama. It is designed to offer a distinct evening activity within Porto's entertainment landscape.

Attendees will find an atmosphere centered around live DJ sets and dancing. The event takes place on a boat, providing a moving perspective of Porto and Vila Nova de Gaia. The duration of the party is set for the evening of August 22, 2026, and it caters to an adult audience interested in music and social events.

Tickets are required for entry. Further details regarding the specific boarding location and public transport connections will be provided closer to the event date. Information on accessibility will also be available from the organizers.
